words.example: There was an abundance of food at the party.

words.meaning: 诱惑力，魅力；v. 诱惑，吸引
words.example: The allure of the big city draws in young graduates every year.
words.exampleZh: 大城市的魅力每年都吸引着年轻毕业生。

words.meaning: 平常的，普通的；n. 老生常谈
words.example: Smartphones have become commonplace in daily life.
words.exampleZh: 智能手机在日常生活中已变得司空见惯。

words.meaning: 涉足，初步尝试（make forays into）；（短暂）突袭
words.example: The company made its first foray into the electric-vehicle market.
words.exampleZh: 该公司首次涉足电动车市场。

words.example: Tokyo is one of the largest metropolises in the world.
words.exampleZh: 东京是世界上最大的大都市之一。

words.example: She remained resolute in her decision to study industrial design.
words.exampleZh: 她坚持学工业设计的决定毫不动摇。

words.example: He wiped the rim of the glass before pouring the wine.
The government took measures to shore up the weakening economy.
words.exampleZh: 政府采取措施支撑走弱的经济。

words.example: The company will unveil its new concept car next month.
words.exampleZh: 该公司下月将发布新款概念车。
